_readme: Settings the Doctor Mobile app adopts. Copy this to custom.dm-app.json and
edit that instead; the custom file wins and survives updates, exactly like
default.clash.yaml / default.sing-box.json next to it.
These are DEFAULTS, not commands. A setting listed here applies only to
users who have never changed it themselves; anyone who has set it keeps
their own value. When a user taps reset-to-defaults they land back on
whatever this file says at that moment, not on what was compiled into the
app - so this is also how you change the app behaviour after release.
Settings are grouped by the core they belong to, so it is clear at a
glance what a given option affects. The grouping is for you, not for the
app: it is flattened away before being sent, so moving a setting between
sections changes nothing, and a section can be left out entirely.
Write values in the form the app stores: log-level as a name (warn),
url-test-interval in seconds, mdns_compression as its number. A value of
the wrong type is skipped rather than applied, and unknown keys are
ignored - so an older app build simply skips what it does not have yet.
Anything starting with _ is a note to whoever edits this and never
reaches a device.
Raise version whenever you edit, so it is obvious in logs which document
a device is running.
force is the exception to the user keeping the last word. Use it when a
setting has stopped working in the field and has to be corrected even on
phones whose owners already changed it:
false                          off - the normal, and the default
["byedpi_args", "mh_stack"]     put these back on every profile update
true                           put ALL of the settings below back
A forced setting is put back each time the user profile updates - it is
not locked, so between updates they can still change it and see the change
take effect. Prefer the list form: true overwrites every setting anyone
has ever chosen, including their core and their DNS, on every update. Keys
listed but not defined below are ignored, so a typo cannot wipe a setting
back to something nobody chose. Names go in flat, whatever section they
sit in.
This file is generated from the app itself, not written by hand:
flutter test --no-pub test/core/dump_defaults.dart
Every value below is the app own default, so publishing it as-is changes
nothing until you actually edit something.

app._: Which core the connect button drives: mihomo | singbox | mdns.

sing-box._: The sing-box core. Dashed names, matching sing-box own options.

evasion._: Anti-censorship levers of the sing-box core. mirage-* is our own TLS-record fragmentation (offset 0 = the measured default).

mihomo._: The mihomo core. mh_block_quic_social stops Instagram stalling on QUIC. mh_store_fake_ip keeps cached fake addresses meaningful after a reconnect. mh_health_check_lazy stops re-testing every node while idle.

mdns._: The MasterDnsVPN DNS-tunnel core. mdns_max_resolvers 0 measures every scanned resolver; set a number only where a full scan takes too long. mdns_dns_cache_* stop a resolved address outliving the tunnel server it came from.

anti-dpi._: The byedpi helper, shared by the sing-box and mihomo cores.
